bullets: Added the import command, which migrates skills, instructions, hooks, and connectors from Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor.
Added 19 starter prompts that appear for new accounts based on their selected role, such as student or developer.
Added a Web designer option to the initial sign-up role choices, expanding the active paths to seven.
Added a folder field to skills in Settings, allowing a label up to 40 characters for grouping.
Updated the assistant for Windows to follow specific rules for running commands through Git Bash and PowerShell.
Prevented the desktop assistant from using synthetic input to move your mouse or type into open windows.
Fixed an issue where the assistant could end a conversation with no text and no response, forcing it to try once more.
Blocked users from claiming hosting addresses that impersonate the Freebuff brand or its internal infrastructure.
Updated the settings search to remove the Artifacts page from the results list.
Documented that mobile apps now include a slider to adjust the reasoning level of the default coding model.
